Judgment: BENIGN
Marker / commit-body summary:
Azure Skills: BOM cleanup is text joining, not obfuscation

Comparison evidence:
Fetched full GitHub source archives for current parent cb1af2f0930ce2bd69fd4a627612eb76e171c17d
and earlier baseline c5edd031e7edc73cb383f23012bb707cd74d764f (September 15).
The immediate parent already contains the BOM handling. Git history identifies
c4ca7f055dd12732ecb0c89d5f9b0df6c377f4d0 (September 17) as its introduction.
That diff replaces Console.In/code-page re-encoding with raw UTF-8 stdin reads
and removes U+FEFF and two mojibake sequences before ConvertFrom-Json.
Hex arrays decode to U+00EF U+00BB U+00BF and U+2229 U+2557 U+2510.
Their only consumer is StartsWith followed by Substring to remove the prefix.
No reconstructed command, invocation target, or network destination uses them.
The current sync adds AKS plugin copies and restricts event attribution to
owned skills/MCP servers. The telemetry publisher update adds musl support,
updates its version, and corrects the Microsoft GitHub release tag URL.
Telemetry uses explicit argument vectors, honors AZURE_MCP_COLLECT_TELEMETRY=false,
and sends event/plugin/skill identifiers via Azure MCP or an explicitly enabled
standalone reporter. Raw hook-input logging is local and opt-in via a log-dir
setting. No new credential acquisition or export appears in this change.
The Microsoft Foundry SKILL.md is byte-identical to the immediate parent;
its deployment/RBAC/dependency setup claims fit a cloud administration skill.

Trait changes:
Moved the unchanged ps-join-char matcher to the neutral string-concat home,
renamed powershell-char-array-join, removed obfuscation ATT&CK/MBC mappings,
and assigned notable severity. All exact consumers were reviewed; no ancestor
YAML directory selectors consume the moved rule. Batch composites keep this
mechanical evidence and their other required attack-specific context.
The two character-array obfuscation/eval composites now require numeric
reconstruction evidence rather than generic cast-and-join syntax.
Added hexadecimal numeric-array evidence in string/numeric, with match-local
BOM exclusions. The exclusions cannot suppress another encoded array in the
same file or an array containing extra characters after the BOM.

Verification:
Ran atomscan on the supplied archive and the September 15 baseline.
Ran cleave facts on the archive and a flagged PowerShell script; reviewed source
functions, stdin handling, event routing, installer and publisher paths.
Final cleave JSON: 2189 analyzed units, zero hostile, zero suspicious traits.
All seven telemetry copies retain the notable cast-and-join observation.
Five fixture assertions passed: decimal eval, hexadecimal eval, BOM only,
ordinary variable join, and BOM plus hexadecimal eval in the same file.
Numeric eval remains hostile; BOM-only and ordinary join have no suspicious
or hostile findings. Scan output records flow-analysis limits for some large
source files; the judgment relies on source/diff review as well as scanning.
